rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an infectious disease itself.

example.english: This contagion is severe; everyone in the village has been infected.
example.traditional: 呢種傳染病好犀利，成村人都中招。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 cyun4 jim5 beng6 hou2 sai1 lei6 seng4 cyun1 jan4 dou1 zung3 ziu1

rows.note: Use this for the transmission of a disease in sense 1, and figuratively for habits or behaviour spreading through a household or community in sense 2.

example.english: The contagion of flu spreads quickly among family members, so everyone needs to be careful.
example.traditional: 流感喺屋企人之間傳染得好快，大家都要小心。
example.jyutping: lau4 gam2 hai2 uk1 kei2 jan4 zi1 gaan1 cyun4 jim5 dak1 hou2 faai3 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 siu2 sam1
